messages.content: How can I obtain the CNAME records for the domain 'sample.com' using the VirusTotal API? You should only return the related object's IDs. My key is 'secret123'.

function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' if State for the city exists. 'City, Country' if State for the city doesn't exist.

unit.description: The unit of temperature for the weather report.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to make live API calls to VirusTotal or retrieve real-time data. If you run the following steps on your own environment, you’ll be able to get the CNAME record IDs:

```bash
# 1. Get the domain object ID
curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com" \
     -H "x-apikey: secret123"

# 2. Extract the domain ID from the response (e.g., "domain_id": "abcd1234")
#    Suppose the ID is "abcd1234".

# 3. Query the DNS records endpoint
curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/abcd1234/dns_records" \
     -H "x-apikey: secret123"

# 4. Filter the returned records for type "CNAME" and collect their IDs.
```

After running these commands, look at the JSON output of step 3. Each DNS record will have an `"id"` field. For all records where `"type": "CNAME"`, list those `"id"` values. Those are the IDs you’re looking for.
